summary: DRG's IT team supports Taco Bell and Arby's, including installation, support and integration of restaurant technology; it is also developing a My DRG employee app spanning payroll, HR, benefits, announcements and applications.
DRG currently reports 341 Taco Bells, 26 Arby's, 9,122 employees and operations in five states; headquarters/Restaurant Support Center is in Las Vegas.
Director of IT Garret Walti manages technology across roughly 370 restaurants and two franchisor technology standards, with current focus including AI, automation and cybersecurity.
